name: McAllen
sourceReview: The City of McAllen GIS portal is a local city custodian and exposes ParcelEditing/MapServer/11 (McAllen Parcels). The layer is polygonal and supports anonymous GeoJSON queries. A bounded geometry-only query at the exact WUP point returned three records.

queryReview.englishDiscovery: Completed; official city portal and parcel layer found.
queryReview.localLanguageDiscovery: For the United States, English is the local/native language; a separate English wording was executed and recorded in the city record.

requestOutcomes: Portal, item metadata, layer schema, and bounded query all returned HTTP 200. Full raw query response is ignored scratch evidence under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/mcallen/.
scopeLimits: Three intersecting polygons establish a local public response only; they do not prove citywide completeness.
Schema includes owner, address, legal-description, value, and other unsafe fields; none were requested or retained.
Service is marked editable in the layer metadata; no writes were attempted.
Runtime readiness remains held pending independent serial adapter review.
uncertainty: No claim is made about parcel absence outside the tested envelope, legal title, ownership, tax records, or service completeness.
